title: Control the yield clock in central settled-history drain regression
outcome: federation_m4_round_two_central_drain_continues_a_settled_history_prefix proves one drain pass traverses settled history and reaches pending work independently of physical two-second expiry.
acceptance: The existing settled-history seed and one-pass pending==0 oracle remain, with an injected/frozen yield clock for this traversal property.
A separate controlled-expiry test verifies production yielding and resumption; production2s budget, cursor rules and peer authority remain unchanged without retry, ignore or inflated timeouts.
